analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. Urolithin A is a gut-microbe metabolite of ellagitannins sold as a supplement ingredient (Mitopure). It extended lifespan in worms, and one 2023 mouse study reported longer life in normal aging mice; no human trial has measured lifespan. Human trials are small (10 to 88 people) and short (4 weeks to 4 months); most were funded by the ingredient's maker; several missed their main goals while reporting secondary signals in strength, endurance, inflammation or immune markers. Reported tolerability was good, but long-term safety data are lacking.
